post.summary: Get the VST upload URL for a new video
post.description: Returns the VST nvstreamer upload URL for the given filename. The UI POSTs file chunks directly to this URL, then calls ``POST /api/v1/videos/{sensor_id}/complete`` to finalize.

Universal completion endpoint. Called by the UI after the last chunk lands, with VST's sensor id as the path param. Runs timeline lookup → storage URL resolution → optional RTVI-CV register → optional embedding generation. Each step skips gracefully if its backing service isn't configured, so this works across profiles; for search profiles the RTVI-CV/embedding hooks drive ingestion.

post.summary: Reprocess an existing recording with a source analysis profile
post.description: Preserves the uploaded media and semantic-search index, removes stale detector-derived evidence, and reruns the recording through exactly one compatible VSS-owned DeepStream worker.

post.summary: Clear generated data for a live stream
post.description: Pauses live analytics, removes source-owned embeddings, detections, behavior, incidents, captions, and optionally retained archive media, then resumes analysis. The VST sensor remains registered.

Stops or restores detection and semantic embedding for one registered live source. The UI history controller coordinates Cosmos captioning with its saved scenario. Retained media and indexed history are unchanged.

InvocationNode.title: InvocationNode
InvocationNode.description:
Represents a node in an invocation call graph.

The InvocationNode class encapsulates the details of a specific function
invocation within a call graph. It stores the unique identifier of the
invocation, the function name, and optional details about the parent
node (if any). This class is useful for tracing the execution flow
in a system or application.

Attributes:
    function_id (str): Unique identifier for the function invocation.
    function_name (str): Name of the function invoked.
    parent_id (str | None): Unique identifier of the parent invocation, if applicable. Defaults to None.
    parent_name (str | None): Name of the parent function invoked, if applicable. Defaults to None.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description:
Enumeration of possible job statuses in the job store.

Attributes
----------
SUBMITTED : str
    Job has been submitted to the scheduler but not yet started.
RUNNING : str
    Job is currently being executed.
SUCCESS : str
    Job completed successfully.
FAILURE : str
    Job failed during execution.
INTERRUPTED : str
    Job was interrupted or cancelled before completion.
NOT_FOUND : str
    Job ID does not exist in the job store.

VideoUploadCompleteInput.title: VideoUploadCompleteInput
VideoUploadCompleteInput.description:
Input for ``POST /api/v1/videos/{sensor_id}/complete``.

The UI forwards the VST upload response as the request body so the
schema stays loose against storage-API churn. Only ``filename`` is read
today (used for the response message and RTVI ``camera_name``); the
rest is ignored.

url.title: Url
url.description: VST nvstreamer endpoint to POST chunks to

text.title: Text
text.description: Text prompt that will be displayed to the user.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the prompt. None means no timeout.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message to display on the prompt if the timeout expires.
error.default: This prompt is no longer available.
